exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Roll out only as far as the ribs can stay down, then pull back.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Rotate the palms outward as the dumbbells travel overhead.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.instructions: Hinge at the hips and rise until the torso lines up with the legs.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Sit down between the hips and stand back up, keeping the whole foot loaded.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the bar with the elbows pinned at the sides.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward and row the bar to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Lift the shoulders straight up and pause briefly at the top.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest with the shoulder blades retracted, then press back up.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rest the rear foot on a bench and lower straight down over the front leg.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Drop to a push-up, jump the feet back in and finish standing.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: Draw both handles together in front of the chest and control the return.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the handle with constant cable tension through the full range.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.instructions: Pull the handle diagonally across the body, turning through the torso.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.instructions: Alternate between rounding and extending the spine on all fours.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions: Lean the torso forward on parallel bars and lower until the shoulders drop below the elbows.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Use an underhand grip and pull the chest toward the bar.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip inside shoulder width and keep the elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.instructions: Place the rear foot against a wall in a half-kneel and stay tall.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: Curl the ribs toward the hips and lower without relaxing fully.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.instructions: Ride at a steady cadence for the planned distance.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with a relaxed shoulder position for time.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Drive the floor away with a neutral spine, keeping the bar close to the legs.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Press from a declined bench, keeping the bar path over the lower chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Press both dumbbells from chest level, letting them travel slightly inward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the dumbbells while keeping the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Open the arms in a wide arc with a soft elbow bend, then bring them back together.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Support the free hand on a bench and row the dumbbell to the hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press both dumbbells from ear height until the arms are extended.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.instructions: Keep a steady stride for the planned time.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull the rope toward the face with the elbows high.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.instructions: Carry a heavy weight in each hand and walk tall for the planned distance.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Lift the dumbbells forward to shoulder height with straight arms.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar on the front delts with the elbows high and squat upright.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a single weight at the chest and squat between the knees.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward with the bar on the upper back and a flat spine.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl with a neutral grip, thumbs pointing up throughout.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.instructions: Hinge over a straight leg until the back of the thigh lengthens.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar and raise the legs without swinging.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.instructions: Push the knees apart against the pads and return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction
exercises.instructions: Squeeze the knees together against the pads and control the return.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instructions: Kneel in a half-lunge and tuck the pelvis until the front of the hip lengthens.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Rest the upper back on a bench and drive the hips to full extension.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.instructions: Press the lower back into the floor and hold the arms and legs off the ground.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and press from the upper chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Press from an inclined bench with the dumbbells starting at upper-chest level.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.instructions: Skip with small hops, turning the rope from the wrists.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: Hinge and snap the hips to float the bell up to chest height.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest while keeping the torso nearly upright.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the pad toward the hips and resist on the way back.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the knees to full lockout and lower under control.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Lower the platform under control and press without locking the knees hard.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Press the handles forward until the arms are extended without locking hard.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: Drive the knees toward the chest from a push-up position.

exercises.name: Neck Curl
exercises.instructions: Nod the chin toward the chest against light resistance.

exercises.name: Neck Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the head backward against light resistance through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Press the bar overhead and finish with the head through the arms.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Lower the weight behind the head and extend the elbows.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a straight line on the forearms with the ribs pulled down.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest the upper arms on the pad and curl without letting the elbows lift.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang with an overhand grip and pull until the chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.instructions: Use a short dip and leg drive to start the bar, then press it to lockout.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels and lower until the chest is near the floor.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull from pins set near knee height and finish standing tall.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward and open the arms out to the sides.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Push the hips back with soft knees and stop when the hamstrings stretch.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.instructions: Drive with the legs, then swing the torso and finish with the arms.

exercises.name: Running
exercises.instructions: Run at a steady effort for the planned distance.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit back at an angle and rotate the torso from side to side.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Pull the handle to the abdomen and let the shoulder blades separate on the return.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Drive the knees up with the balls of the feet on the platform.

exercises.name: Shoulder Dislocate
exercises.instructions: Pass a band overhead and behind the back with straight arms.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Stack the hips and hold the body in a straight line on one forearm.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lower the bar toward the forehead and press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.instructions: Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps and a braced torso.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.instructions: Climb at a steady pace without leaning on the handles.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the toes with straight knees and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.instructions: Drive through the top foot without pushing off the trailing leg.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Sweep the bar down to the thighs with the elbows almost locked.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Take a wide stance with the hands inside the knees and push the floor apart.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.instructions: Swim the planned distance at a steady effort.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Row the handles to the chest while keeping the hips hinged.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation
exercises.instructions: Rotate the upper back while keeping the hips still.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand inside the frame and stand up tall with the handles at the sides.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.instructions: Stay upright on the bars and lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Extend the elbows down to full lockout with the upper arms fixed.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar up along the body with the elbows leading.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward into a lunge and drive through to the next step.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest the forearms on a bench and curl only at the wrists.
